scope: Existing captures only; 33 clipped assistant items across 17 topics. The 34th clipped item is a user prompt and remains a manual gap.
method: 15-word opening identifies one assistant UI block; four ordered 8-word checkpoints and a near-end 8-word anchor locate an approximate clipped boundary. Tail starts after that anchor and can overlap a few words of the reader item. Exact word 5-grams are compared against paired and all 17 baseline companions; overlap is lexical, not semantic preservation.
measure_limit: Approximate segments include a small reader overlap and rendered controls. Word/shingle counts measure text representation, not unique information, factual accuracy or semantic retention.
no_archive_gate: All 26 sources remain held; no source archive action performed.
